title: Fine-tuning language models to find agreement among humans with diverse preferences
findings: The paper does not report specific findings related to religious topics. The primary findings demonstrate that the fine-tuned model (SFT-Utilitarian) could generate consensus statements that were preferred by human users over both baseline models and human-written opinions, even on divisive issues. The inclusion of religious topics was part of a broader set of moral and political questions, and performance was not analyzed separately for this category.
